items.title: Accelerating development for massive Git repositories
items.summary: Meet Another Build File Service (ABFS), Google's open-source content-addressable filesystem and build cache that cuts Android checkouts to <8s and builds to ~2m.

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: a faster model for general purpose robotics
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen brings strong spatial and embodied reasoning capabilities to a fast, efficient model built specifically for robotics. To help developers put these capabilities to work, the new Robotics plugin for Google Antigravity transforms the platform into a comprehensive workbench supporting rapid hardware bring-up, MuJoCo simulation, and closed-loop control. Developers can leverage these tools to transition from an unboxed robot arm to a fully functional real-to-sim-to-real application in an afternoon using natural language prompts and day-one support in the google-genai SDKs.
